question: Find the area of a rhombus whose perimeter is 164 cm and one diagonal is of length 80 cm.
solution:
**Given:**

Perimeter of the rhombus = 164 cm

Length of one diagonal = 80 cm

**Formula used:**

Perimeter of Rhombus = 4 × Side

Side = (1)/(2) sqrt{(d₁² + d₂²)}

Area of rhombus = (1)/(2)(d1 × d2)

**Calculation:**

According to the question,

Perimeter of the rhombus = 164 cm

4 × Side = 164

⇒ Side = (164)/(4) = 41 cm

Also, d₁ = 80 cm (given)

Side = (1)/(2) sqrt{(d₁² + d₂²)}

⇒ 41 × 2 = sqrt{(80² + d₂²)}

⇒ d22 = 82² - 80²

⇒ d22 = 6724 - 6400

⇒ d22 = 324

⇒ d2 = 18 cm

Now Area of the rhombus,

Area of rhombus = (1)/(2)(d1 × d2)

⇒ A = (1)/(2) (80 × 18)

⇒ A = (1440)/(2) = 720 cm² 

**∴ The area of the rhombus is 720 cm2 .**
